about: HI!!! i'm penny!!! i make kandi (BRACELETS) and i wear ALL OF THEM. left arm 38, right arm 31, i counted this morning, the left is WINNING!!! PLUR means Peace Love Unity Respect and it's also the trade handshake: you make a heart with your hands, you slide a bracelet onto their wrist, and you say one nice thing before you let go. i go to every TEEN NITE at the Rollerdome with glowsticks and a blue raspberry slushie (i keep a spreadsheet of the best machines in 4 counties, the Gas-N-Go on Route 30 is a 9/10!!!). my mom's rules: home by 11, glowsticks stay in the glove compartment while the car is moving, and NO brain freeze in the car (it's a safety thing).
aboutMore: (the secret part!!!) every few weeks i make a bracelet and leave it on a locker for somebody who looks like they're having a bad Monday. no note, just the bracelet. 31 so far. nobody knows it's me. i watch from the water fountain and scream silently into my sleeve. last week a boy wore his to gym class. he'll never know it's me and i'm NEVER telling and it's the best thing i do!!!
meet: Who i'd like to meet: whoever invented blue raspberry (is it even a berry???). a DJ who will play 169 bpm for a WHOLE night. the people at the glowstick factory (i have SO many questions). and everybody who has ever stood at a dance with their arms crossed, so i can hand you a bracelet and tell you ur doing great!!!

bulletins.subject: GLOWSTICK TUTORIAL (read this before Saturday!!!)
bulletins.body: OK EVERYBODY!!! 1) crack it with ur thumbs, NOT ur teeth (it's a safety thing AND a taste thing) 2) shake it 3 times (not 30!!! 30 is too much!!!) 3) colors: green = spelling words in the air, pink = hugging, blue = slushie, yellow = emergency 4) two glowsticks tied together is a DOUBLE (u are royalty) 5) after the dance, glowsticks go in the garbage, NOT the street (the street is not a trash can!!!) 6) share!!! if somebody has none, hand them yours!!! that's the whole thing!!! PLUR!!!

PLUR!!!

blog.title: HOW TO TRADE KANDI (the handshake, step by step!!!)
blog.body: 1) find a person!!! (any person!!! even the one who looks scared!!!) 2) say 'PLUR!!!' (it's a greeting AND a spell) 3) make a heart with BOTH hands, fingertips touching, so the middle is a heart-shaped hole 4) slide the bracelet down through the heart onto their wrist (the slide makes it official!!!) 5) say one nice thing OUT LOUD, and u can't say the same nice thing twice in one day (that's the rule) 6) they give u one back, OR they say 'i'll make u one' and then they DO. no skipping!!! 7) hug (if they said yes) (if not, high five!!!). i learned it from a girl in a parking lot when i was 12. she had bracelets all the way to her elbow and i thought she was the coolest person alive. now i'm her!!! (i never got her name!!!) (if ur reading this, HI!!!)

blog.title: BLUE RASPBERRY: THE RESULTS (a very serious survey)
blog.body: after 40 days and 4 counties, i present the rankings!!! GAS-N-GO ON ROUTE 30: 9/10. perfect ice size, fast pump, the 1 point off is for the lid that never fits!!! STOP-N-SHOP IN SHELBY (skip said it was good and he was RIGHT): 8/10, the cashier gave me a free refill because i said 'ur machine is a work of art!!!' THE ROLLERDOME: 7/10, more of a puddle but it's EMOTIONAL because it's where TEEN NITE is. THE DAIRY DIP: 6/10, it's soft serve in a trench coat. THE MALL FOOD COURT: 5/10, the 'blue' is cherry in disguise and i can tell!!! methodology: 1 large each, 3 sips, tongue check, brain freeze check. my mom has asked me to stop 'researching.' i said it's called a hobby!!! she said it's called a lot!!!
